plan.direction: 4h UTC long-only spot time-series momentum with same-slot relative quote-volume confirmation
plan.hypothesis: An intermediate 4h close-to-close momentum signal confirmed by elevated same-slot quote turnover may avoid low-liquidity false entries; compare 6/12/24-bar momentum and volume ratios 1.00/1.25/1.50 on BTC and ETH.
plan.rule: For completed UTC 4h bar i, define momentum as close[i-1]/close[i-1-lookback]-1. Compute relative volume as quote_volume[i-1] divided by the arithmetic mean of quote_volume from the prior 20 observations of the same UTC 4h slot (i-7, i-13, ..., i-121); current bar is excluded. Flat enters when momentum>0 and relative volume>=threshold. Long exits when momentum<=0, regardless of volume. Otherwise retain desired state. Signals use closed bars only; execution at the next block start+1 minute open. No leverage, shorting, scale-in, rebalance, cross-asset transfer, or pre-OOS trades. Each asset/config has independent 2000 USDT initial cash.
plan.accounting: Independent $2,000 account per asset/config. Preserve cash and units, maximum affordable buy, whole sale, no yield/rebalance. Terminal liquidation is costed.

gates.interpretation: A pass is a repeated-history screen only; no independent/forward profitability claim.

source_literature.citation: Shen, D., Urquhart, A., & Wang, P. (2022). Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum. Financial Review, 57(2), 319–344. DOI:10.1111/fire.12290.
source_literature.use: Motivates testing a predeclared intraday momentum and volume confirmation rule; this 4h rule is an adaptation, not a replication.

data.source: Binance spot 1m OHLCV, normalized closed bars
data.reuse_disclosure: The full period is repeatedly used development/validation history and is not an untouched final holdout.

walk_forward.parameter_fit: None; all rule parameters frozen before evaluation. Each fold uses only already completed bars for signal and lagged cost inputs. OOS account starts flat and carries state continuously across adjacent test folds.

execution.reference: Next UTC 4h block first one-minute open, at block_start+60s; prior 4h close is available at block_start. Decimal fill reuses research/experiments/20261001T133655Z/kernel.py and existing market filter snapshot. Historical L2 is unavailable; fill costs and 5m VWAP are estimated. No real orders.

costs.impact_formula: 0.5 * sample_std(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order_budget / mean_quote_volume(previous 20 complete UTC days))

plan.selection_bias: Registry currently has zero spot 4h volume-confirmed momentum entries. This batch is 20 preregistered definitions; no result-based specification edits. All history reused.
